data.content_ref: inline:The fragility profile (SRC_007) reduces to the DefenseWitness computation (SRC_002): an accepted node is fragile under single-edge deletion iff deleting an edge removes a member of its greedy defense witness that is uniquely responsible for some attacker. This reduction gives fragility auditing in O(V+E) without re-running the fixpoint per edge. Refuted if: there exists a graph where an accepted node's label changes under single-edge deletion but no witness member is uniquely responsible for any attacker, so fragility is not witness-detectable.
